definition.name: Three-phase distribution board
definition.description: This steel board has a main supply position and two facing rows of breakers. The earth wire connects to the stud marked PE on the case.

terminals.label: PE
terminals.purpose: Earth connection for the fitting. The earth path stays connected when the switch opens.

parts.name: Housing
parts.purpose: The case holds the working parts in place and keeps them apart.

parts.name: Removable cover
parts.purpose: Lift the cover on the bench to see the connections underneath.

parts.name: Terminal clamps
parts.purpose: A clamp holds the bare end of a wire against the metal terminal.

parts.name: Mounting and fixings
parts.purpose: These keep the fitting in place. Look for the screws or clips that hold it.

parts.name: Device rail
parts.purpose: Breakers clip onto this metal rail. The wires and bars carry the current.

parts.name: Outer door
parts.purpose: Open the door to reach the breaker handles. The front panel still covers the wiring.

parts.name: Removable front panel
parts.purpose: The openings leave the breaker handles within reach while the panel covers the wires.

terminals.label: PE
terminals.purpose: Earth connection for the fitting. The earth path stays connected when the switch opens.

data.detailPurpose: The back pan supports the rails and contains the wiring. Removable cable-entry plates sit at the top and bottom.
Devices clip onto the steel top-hat section. Each numbered position occupies one 18 mm module.
The removable insulating front leaves access to the device operating handles.
The hinged outer door protects the controls. A separate dead front covers the terminal wiring.
